brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu rejected a Gaza reconstruction plan promoted by US President Donald Trump, according to Middle East Eye. Netanyahu said Israel would not withdraw its military from the territory until Hamas "genuinely" disarms, effectively blocking a cornerstone of Trump's proposal.

The public rejection marks a rare divergence between Netanyahu and Trump on Middle East strategy. Trump had unveiled the 15-point plan as a potential pathway to regional stability and Gaza's postwar reconstruction. Netanyahu's stance suggests significant obstacles remain to any international agreement on ending the conflict and rebuilding the enclave.
